name: lcr_lakeflow_pipeline
_comment: Lakeflow Declarative Pipeline for the raw->gold LCR medallion. Target schema cfo.aura_bank_lakeflow is intentionally parallel to the live cfo.aura_bank schema so the ingestion leg never touches the tables the app serves. Create with: databricks pipelines create --json @resources/lcr_lakeflow_pipeline.json ; seed raw files first by running notebook/lcr_lakeflow_seed.
